verdict.rationale: Baseten is an inference and training platform, and an in-product AI assistant that surfaces insights from workspace data such as usage or spend is plausible for it, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows developer building blocks: hosted Model APIs, structured outputs and function calling that a user could use to build such a feature. It also shows an MCP server and skill that let an external coding agent manage the workspace, which is a different capability. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the product itself.
